primary_name: Lionel Giles, Sun Tzŭ on the Art of War, introduction
summary: 1910 English translation with a critical introduction, translating Sima Qian's biography and summarising the Song-dynasty arguments against Sun Wu's existence.
bias_notes: Dated: written before the 1972 bamboo-slip find.
title: Sun Tzŭ on the Art of War
reliability_notes: Public domain. His translations and summaries of the older Chinese debate remain useful; his conclusions are dated.
